title: Plan-35 prep: tighten events schema and validation policy
body: Post Plan-34: validator is tolerant and events schema required fields were relaxed. After ISS-0024 promotes ok/source/context to top-level in normalized lines, tighten JSON Schema (ok/exit_code required, consider ts format), set ArtifactReport.ok based on invalid==0, and consider making summary_ok fail when invalid>0. Document changes and update tests accordingly.
